Interesting links of the week:

Strategy:

* https://ncsi.ega.ee/ncsi-index/?order=rank&type=c - the Estonians publish their latest league table
* https://lauriehocking.com/adversarial-learning-framework/alf-141/ - an alternate approach to scoring cyber damage
* https://www.frc.org.uk/library/standards-codes-policy/corporate-governance/uk-corporate-governance-code/ - hey, it's the FCA on the line, what's our corporate governance strategy
* https://www.schiff.senate.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Summary_Water-Cyber-Shield-Act.pdf - when it pours, it pours
* https://blog.google/security/the-evolving-role-of-the-red-team-in-the-era-of-agentic-security/ - the GOOG view on red teams 🤖
* https://defconfranklin.com/almanack.html - a summary view of DEF CON

Threats:

* https://www.sk-cert.sk/sk/varovanie-pred-rizikami-cestnych-meradiel/index.html - .sk CERT warns us about road cameras
* https://media.defense.gov/2026/Aug/18/2003983494/-1/-1/1/CSA_ACTIVE_THREAT_TO_SIEMENS_S7_SERIES_PLCS.PDF - water, PLCs and threat actors shouldn't mix
* https://www.githubstatus.com/incidents/zkxwbgr0cnmx - sometimes the threat is just a bug in your planning

Detection:

* https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/linux-ir-auditd-incident-responders-taz-wake-btmhe/ - @tazwake's latest contribution to improving Linux detection approaches
* https://rknight.me/robots.txt - robots everywhere according to @robb@social.lol
* https://zakird.com/papers/ip_sharing.pdf - can you still trust an IP as an IOC?

Bugs:

* https://mysk.blog/2026/08/04/webkit-proxy-icloud-private-relay-ip-leak/ - webkit still leaky say @mysk@mastodon.social

Exploitation:

* https://lina.sh/blog/hijacking-e164-arpa - @lina@ohai.social hijacks some telco
* https://crt.name/v1/search?apex=x.com - a neat view onto CT logs
* https://portswigger.net/research/css-the-bomb-inside-your-inbox - fresh new mean HTML from the very stylish Mr @gaz
* https://www.usenix.org/conference/usenixsecurity25/presentation/pasquini - stealing a model's fingerprints 🤖

Hard hacks:

* https://www.dragos.com/blog/ai-vulnerability-detection-ot-security-methodology - hunting OT bugs with LLM 🤖
* https://www.usenix.org/system/files/woot26-lisowski.pdf - SIMs can be naughty too

Nerd:

* https://chrisburnell.com/html-can-do-that/ - HTML is eating JavaScript's breakfast

#security, #research
